review_summary: Round 1 was too sparse: the face became a ring, the blue wrap and garment read as disconnected bars, and the hanging cloth was too chunky. Replace the worst base actions and regroup the large masses before adding features.

actions.intent: replace the ring-like face with one continuous warm head mass
actions.decision: The round-1 tangent strokes left a hollow center and protruding ring. Repaint the face as overlapping broad oblique strokes inside a slightly smaller oval.

actions.intent: turn the head by separating the darker right/back side
actions.decision: The reference face is brighter on the left/front and darker toward the ear and neck. Add only one broad shadow-side passage, without features.

actions.intent: replace separated blue bars with one wrapped blue band
actions.decision: The blue wrap needs to read as a continuous band around the skull. Use broader overlapping strokes and keep the lower edge above the eyes.

actions.intent: give the blue wrap a darker lower-right mass
actions.decision: The lower-right half of the blue wrap is markedly darker in the reference. Establish this as one shadow mass, not small folds yet.

actions.intent: cover the picket-fence garment strokes with a continuous jacket mass
actions.decision: The jacket needs a single heavy mass first. Overlap fewer but much broader strokes; leave the dry underpaint only as buried texture.

actions.intent: connect the head to the collar with the dark neck passage
actions.decision: Round 1 left a background gap under the jaw. The reference has a dark neck/ear passage that connects the head to the collar.

actions.intent: replace the chunky right-side bars with a narrower hanging cloth
actions.decision: The hanging cloth is long and narrow. The round-1 version was too wide and lumpy, so repaint it with a tighter polygon and longer vertical strokes.

actions.intent: make the collar a continuous light wedge
actions.decision: The collar was broken into isolated pale capsules. Reinforce it with a few broad overlapping strokes before any white highlights.
